title: Look-alike burst: checkout questions
purpose: Restraint. Six tickets about paying at checkout arrive together, but five are questions, not failures. Topic similarity alone must not open an incident.

tickets.body: Can I pay for my order at checkout with two different cards?
Is EMI available as a payment option at checkout for orders above ₹10,000?
How do I apply a coupon code when paying at checkout?
Can I pay by UPI at checkout instead of using a card?
Does checkout accept my wallet balance as payment?
Got a payment error at checkout once, but it worked when I retried.
